pokedexEntries.di: It agilely scales sheer cliffs to live atop craggy mountains. Its fire is put out when it sleeps.

pokedexEntries.prl: Its fiery rear end is fueled by gas made in its belly. Even rain can’t extinguish the fire.

pokedexEntries.pt: It is very agile. Before going to sleep, it extinguishes the flame on its tail to prevent fires.

pokedexEntries.hgss: The gas made in its belly burns from its rear end. The fire burns weakly when it feels sick.
